parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the cooling of water.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Use the thermometer to measure room temperature θ R . θ R = ........................................................ [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) • Pour 200 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Place the thermometer in the beaker. • Measure the temperature θ of the hot water in the beaker and immediately start the stopclock. • Record this temperature in Table 3.1 at time t = 0. • Continue recording the temperature θ of the water every 60 s until you have a total of six sets of readings of time and temperature in Table 3.1. • Complete the column headings in Table 3.1.
